noiseDerivation.noiseDefinition: BFV noise e = [c0 + c1*s - floor(Q/t)*m]_Q (centred), m = the stored plaintext polynomial, coefficients in [0, t)
noiseDerivation.errorBoundSource: OpenFHE DGG (Peikert inversion): sigma = 3.19f, |e| <= ceil(sigma*12.00610553538285) = 39, else OPENFHE_THROW (core/include/math/discretegaussiangenerator-impl.h:81-82,94-99)
noiseDerivation.inputNoiseFormula: Be*(1 + 2*N*Bs) + max_l ceil(r_l*(t-1)/t), r_l = Q_l mod t, l over the numbers of limbs at which the trace encrypts: phase = v*e_pk + e0 + e1*s + ceil(Q*m/t) and ceil(Q*m/t) - floor(Q/t)*m = ceil(r*m/t) for m in [0,t)
noiseDerivation.inputNoiseSource: PKEBFVRNS::Encrypt(DCRTPoly, PublicKey) (pke/lib/scheme/bfvrns/bfvrns-pke.cpp:167-223): EncryptZeroCore (pke/lib/schemerns/rns-pke.cpp:152-200: c0 = pk0*v + ns*e0, c1 = pk1*v + ns*e1, v from the ternary generator, ns = 1), pk = (ns*e - a*s, a) (bfvrns-pke.cpp:88-90); then c0 += TimesQovert(ptxt) (bfvrns-pke.cpp:204-206; core/include/lattice/hal/default/dcrtpoly-impl.h:918-935: every residue x -> [x * (-Q mod t)]_t * t^-1 mod q_i, i.e. the integer (Q*m + [-Q*m]_t)/t = ceil(Q*m/t)); EXTENDED: the same modulo Q*px with px = PreviousPrime(q_last) (bfvrns-cryptoparameters.cpp:78,97-122; bfvrns-pke.cpp:182-189,197-200), then ScaleAndRoundPOverQ on both components (bfvrns-pke.cpp:211-214; dcrtpoly-impl.h:1699-1714; the lift of the px-residue is centred: core/lib/math/hal/intnat/mubintvecnat.cpp:217-237)
noiseDerivation.keyNoiseFormula: Be: key-switching keys b = -a*s' + e (+ the key material), noise scale 1 (pke/lib/keyswitch/keyswitch-hybrid.cpp:91,120,123; keyswitch-bv.cpp:64,98-101)
noiseDerivation.keyProvenance: checked from the trace: every Encrypt key comes from one traced single-party CryptoContext::KeyGen(); every relinearization/rotation key used was generated from its secret key by a traced EvalMultKeyGen/EvalMultKeysGen/rotation-key generation for the index used; no multiparty, proxy re-encryption or key-switching call in the trace
noiseDerivation.plaintextBound: t-1: packed encoding lifts every coefficient of the inverse-NTT'd slot vector to [0, t) and stores the same integer in every limb (pke/lib/encoding/packedencoding.cpp:74-86,115-131); EvalMult(ct, pt) multiplies every component by that polynomial (pke/lib/schemerns/rns-leveledshe.cpp:263-278, NORESCALE branch), and EvalAdd/EvalSub(ct, pt) add TimesQovert of it (bfvrns-leveledshe.cpp:56-96)

plainAdd.source: LeveledSHEBFVRNS::EvalAddInPlace/EvalSubInPlace(Ciphertext, Plaintext) (pke/lib/scheme/bfvrns/bfvrns-leveledshe.cpp:56-96) add TimesQovert(p) to c0 (core/include/lattice/hal/default/dcrtpoly-impl.h:918-935): residue-wise [p*(-Q mod t)]_t * t^-1 mod q_i, which is the integer (Q*p + [-Q*p]_t)/t = CEIL(Q*p/t) for the stored p in [0,t) -- not floor(Q/t)*p ('delta') and not the rounding to nearest ('rounded'): ceil(Q*p/t) - floor(Q/t)*p = ceil((Q mod t)*p/t), which exceeds the 'rounded' deviation floor(((Q mod t)*p + t/2)/t) by one whenever the fractional part of (Q mod t)*p/t lies in (0, 1/2). deviationBound = max of ceil((Q_l mod t)*(t-1)/t) over the numbers of limbs l of the plaintext operands of this trace ([1, 2]; every level if there is none)

keySwitching.source: KeySwitchHYBRID (pke/lib/keyswitch/keyswitch-hybrid.cpp): keys b = -a*s' + e + P*s on the digit's limbs, noise scale 1 (:91-123); digit j at l limbs = limbs [j*alpha, min((j+1)*alpha, l)), numPartQl = ceil(l/alpha) (:300-314); ModUp by the canonical-representative fast base conversion; ModDown is ApproxModDown with t = 0 (:256-269: noise scale 1), i.e. (X - FastBConv([X]_P))/P without the BGV t-correction. Under HPSPOVERQLEVELED the switch runs on the first L - internalDrop limbs and the result is multiplied by Q/Q_l (provenance: internalDrop)

modSwitch.source: LeveledSHEBFVRNS::Compress (pke/lib/scheme/bfvrns/bfvrns-leveledshe.cpp:902-932): per dropped limb, DropLastElementAndScale of every component (dcrtpoly-impl.h:737-755): (c - [c]_{q_last})/q_last with the centred [c]_{q_last} (mubintvecnat.cpp:191-215), i.e. round(c/q_last)

decryption.source: PKEBFVRNS::Decrypt (pke/lib/scheme/bfvrns/bfvrns-pke.cpp:225-278) computes round(t*[c0 + c1*s]_Q/Q) mod t. IDEALISED here as the exact rounding at the output's level. What the library does: (a) an output with all L limbs: the RNS ScaleAndRound (:238-253), for the HPS techniques with a double-precision sum of the fractional parts (dcrtpoly-impl.h:1220-1388; the comments there bound the float error by 1/4), for BEHZ with the gamma-corrected integer procedure (dcrtpoly-impl.h:1652-1696; gamma = 2^26); neither is exact rounding when the phase is within the procedure's error of a rounding boundary. (b) an output with fewer limbs (after Compress): the PHASE is switched down to one limb by DropLastElementAndScale and then rounded with MultiplyAndRound(t, q_0) (:254-275); each switch adds at most 1/2 to the phase error, which this declaration does not account for

mean.source: declared assumption for the sigma = 3.19 encryption sampler: |mean| <= 3431/2^64 for every coefficient of (u, e1, e2) = OpenFHE's (v, e0, e1), support -27..26; ternary sampler uniform on {-1, 0, 1} (mean 0)

freshEncryption.source: PKEBFVRNS::Encrypt(DCRTPoly, PublicKey), STANDARD (bfvrns-pke.cpp:167-223; rns-pke.cpp:152-200): (b*v + e0 + ceil(Q*m/t), a*v + e1), b = e - a*s (bfvrns-pke.cpp:88-90, noise scale 1); v ternary (TUG), e, e0, e1 from the DGG with |e| <= 39 (discretegaussiangenerator-impl.h:81-82,94-99)

multiplication.source: HPS (Halevi-Polyakov-Shoup): sizeQ + 1 auxiliary primes R = PreviousPrime chain below q_last, read from GetParamsRl (pke/lib/scheme/bfvrns/bfvrns-cryptoparameters.cpp:78-79,128-142); the base extensions and the scaling use double-precision estimates of the overflow/quotient (dcrtpoly-impl.h ExpandCRTBasis/SwitchCRTBasis/ScaleAndRound with the *Frac tables and m_qInv, bfvrns-cryptoparameters.cpp:263-289); EvalMult: ExpandCRTBasis of both operands to Q u R, tensor, ScaleAndRound by t/Q into R, SwitchCRTBasis R -> Q (bfvrns-leveledshe.cpp:224-237,364-379)
